title: Finance > Payment Gateways > How to Set Up Stripe Payment Gateway

sections.heading: Overview of Stripe Integration
sections.content: Brilliant Directories natively integrates with Stripe to process credit card payments, recurring membership subscriptions, paid lead purchases, and digital product sales. It fully supports Stripe SCA (Strong Customer Authentication) and 3D Secure 2 compliance.

sections.heading: Step-by-Step Stripe Setup
sections.content:
1. Navigate in your Admin Dashboard to Finance > Payment Gateways.
2. In the Gateway Dropdown, select 'Stripe'.
3. Click the blue 'Connect with Stripe' button or manually input your Stripe Publishable Key and Secret Key.
4. Ensure your Stripe Webhook endpoint is copied from BD into your Stripe Dashboard at Developers > Webhooks (endpoint: https://yourdomain.com/stripe_webhook.php).
5. Set Webhook events to listen for: 'invoice.payment_succeeded', 'customer.subscription.deleted', and 'charge.refunded'.

sections.heading: Supported Currencies and Test Mode
sections.content: Stripe supports over 135 currencies. You can toggle 'Test Mode' on in Finance > Payment Gateways to test signup flows with Stripe 4242 test card numbers before switching to Live Mode.
